request.spec:
A name or alias may no longer be used on a sheet when any sheet of its tree (its ancestors, its
descendants and their descendants, among the sheets that exist) already uses it as a name or alias:
adding, renaming, an alias, the quick-add bar, the paste box (and any later import) are refused as a
duplicate would be. People who already clash are not changed: each shows clashing yes, and every
edit of them through the person form is refused until the edit renames them to a name that does not
clash (and leaves no clashing alias).

FIRST read AGENTS.md — it states the working rules and how the app is tested, and sends you to

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
A name or alias may no longer be used on a sheet when any sheet of its tree (its ancestors, its
descendants and their descendants, among the sheets that exist) already uses it as a name or alias:
adding, renaming, an alias, the quick-add bar, the paste box (and any later import) are refused as a
duplicate would be. People who already clash are not changed: each shows clashing yes, and every
edit of them through the person form is refused until the edit renames them to a name that does not
clash (and leaves no clashing alias).

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, test data and any audit

you work; iterate until it passes. Change whatever the request needs across the app — its stored
data, its server and its front end. Do NOT edit bin/build, bin/start, bin/stop, bin/e2e,
AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, DESIGN.md, e2e/support/ or the test spec.

agent.result_text:
A name or alias can no longer be used on a sheet if any other sheet in its tree (its ancestors and all its descendants) already uses it. `bin/e2e` now passes all 4 acceptance tests; before the change, all 4 failed.

**What is refused** (case and surrounding spaces ignored, refused like an existing duplicate):
- **Adding or renaming a person**, and **adding an alias**: refused if the name is used anywhere else in the tree, as well as on the sheet itself.
- **Quick-add**: a new name that is used elsewhere in the tree is refused instead of creating a person. Adding to someone already on the sheet works as before.
- **Paste box**: no change was needed. It never creates people, so a name that isn't on the sheet was already refused.
- **Transfer**, the only import of people: the person's name and aliases must also be free across the destination sheet's tree. The person's own entries don't count, so moving someone from a child sheet to its parent isn't blocked by their own name.

**People who already clash**:
- Each person row has a new `person-clashing` column showing `yes` or `no`. It is worked out when the people list is read, from how the tree stands at that moment, so nothing new is stored and no database migration was needed.
- Every edit through the person form for someone who clashes is refused until it gives them a name that doesn't clash. If one of their existing aliases clashes, every edit is refused, and since there's no way to remove an alias, that person can't be edited through the form at all.

**Where the changes are:**
- `SheetRepository.tree`: finds a sheet's ancestors and descendants. Going up the parents stops if it reaches a sheet it has already seen, so a loop can't run forever.
- `PersonRepository`: new `nameTakenIn`, `namesIn` and `clashes`.
- `CheckPersonName`, `AddAlias`, `FindQuickAddPerson` and `TransferPerson`: use the tree-wide check.
- `PersonResponse`, `RespondWithPeople` and `RespondWithPerson`: return the new `clashing` field.
- Front end: the column is added in `people.ts` and `people.slot.tsx`.

The clash display is calculated from the tree as it is now, even when the sheet is viewed as of a past date.
